content.text: Analyst who turns messy operational data into clear weekly decisions.
Cut weekly reporting from two days to two hours with SQL and Python.
Built a dashboard that six teams use to track late deliveries.
Cleaned six sales sources and found a 4% double count.
Compared three routing methods on real delivery data.
